label: Blind sample 089: Hansen forest loss 2020, tile 50N_130W

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.17 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.19 to −0.02). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.17); radar is inconclusive (radar backscatter (VH) −0.0 dB, interval −0.3 to −0.0).
